<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the chemical shift values are 167.15, 143.85, 130.30, 34.53 (appears twice), 22.80, 21.35, and 19.20 ppm. The duplicate 34.53 ppm indicates two carbons in the same environment. Counting each distinct shift once gives 7 unique carbon environments.</thought>
<final_answer>7</final_answer>
